description: Source code for the Zephyr driver of the LiteOn LTR-F216A I2C illuminance sensor, including register definitions, initialization, data fetching, and sensor API implementation.

methods.name: ltrf216a_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample from the sensor, enabling measurement and reading data registers.

methods.name: ltrf216a_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sample data into sensor value in microlux units.

methods.name: ltrf216a_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifying device ID.
